title: CheaperAnvil_DataPack
body:
This Data Pack makes the recipe cheaper for an anvil, using only 7 inron ingots. I've tested this pack which is for 1.21.10, will soon update for future versions. If it doesn't work , problem might be on your side and I'm not able to help. Enjoy , more packs on the way!! IMPORTANT!! Please do not reupload as your own, no reuploads are allowed, if you do, there will be consequences. You may use the pack in videos, but provide link back to me and give proper credit. You may also link my youtube video from my channel on this pack if you can't properly credit me. Channel link > ( https://youtube.com/@rebelfalconer7883?si=NKpsdMZ1ZgCUJFbz )

Not needed, but donations via PayPayl is appreciated,username = @gemicsounds
